series: JLPT N3 grammar series; denominator = 220 Bunpro N3 entries (n3-coverage-matrix, frozen)
levelPolicy: Bunpro precedence (docs/jlpt-levels.md); Rule A owning level kept; Rule B both Sensei and SKM at N3; Rule C N2 only where the exact sense is supported at N2 and N3 placement cannot be verified.

primarySources.use: N3 placement; Noun + こそ; こちらこそ, 今度こそ and そんな時こそ patterns
N3 placement; なんか mostly after nouns, なんて also after verbs and quotations; humble, dismissive and surprised uses
N3 placement; V-dictionary / V-ない / Noun + に限る; 'nothing better than' and 'limited to' senses; contrast with とは限らない
N3 placement; Noun + だけしか + negative as emphatic 'only, nothing but'
N5 placement of だけ (basis for one-objection's jlpt 5 label); だけ is the contrast side in three exercises
N3 placement; Number + Counter + おきに; 'every' with small units versus 'leaving a gap of' with days; caution about ごとに
N3 placement; それぞれ + phrase and それぞれの + noun; 人それぞれ
N3 placement of ずつ (Number + Counter + ずつ); owning set is quantity-zutsu

supplementarySources.supports: こそ listed at JLPT N3, Noun + こそ, 'for sure; precisely; definitely' (inspected 2026-11-17)

supplementarySources.publisher: Agency for Cultural Affairs (文化庁), 現代仮名遣い 本文 第2
supplementarySources.supports: ひとりずつ is listed among words written with ず as the main rule but which may also be written with づ; basis for accepting づつ as a typed variant (inspected 2026-11-17)

dispositions.levelEvidence: Bunpro N3; JLPT Sensei N3 (page inspected); SKM not checked
dispositions.note: Four contexts: こちらこそ reply, 今度こそ resolve, これこそ identification, evaluative Xこそ…一番. からこそ is owned by the cause-emphasis-purpose set and is not targeted here.

dispositions.levelEvidence: Bunpro N3; Sensei not verified; SKM not checked
dispositions.note: Light entry (3 exercises): adverbial それぞれ, それぞれ before a quantity (ずつ, which follows a quantity, is the positional distractor), and 人それぞれ. ごとに is not a construction in this set (N4 in the quantity-scope ledger); it is discussed in the article.

dispositions.levelEvidence: Bunpro N3; Sensei not verified; SKM not checked
dispositions.note: Contrasted with だけ + negative (single exception) and だけ + affirmative. one-guest-absent and math-unfinished target だけ but are labelled jlpt 3 because each turns on the N3 だけ / だけしか contrast with a negative predicate (review FLI-B-01). one-objection stays jlpt 5 (Bunpro places だけ at N5) only because its だけしか distractor is malformed with the affirmative predicate 反対しました, so the item practises plain だけ rather than the N3 contrast.

dispositions.levelEvidence: Bunpro N3; Sensei not verified; SKM not checked
dispositions.note: Covered by quantity-zutsu. Two new contrast exercises target ずつ only because the validator requires every relationship construction to be a target: 一行ずつ versus 一行おきに, and 少しずつ (gradual change). A ずつ item directly after 二つ was dropped because the それぞれ distractor (二つそれぞれ) could not be ruled out with full confidence.

dispositions.levelEvidence: Bunpro N3; Sensei not verified (page blocked); SKM not checked
dispositions.note: Two task types: interpretation of the 'nothing beats' versus 'limited to' sense, and conversion choosing dictionary or ない form before に限る. とは限らない is owned by the advice-certainty-denial set.

dispositions.levelEvidence: Bunpro N3; Sensei not verified (page not found); SKM not checked
dispositions.note: Noun items accept both なんか and なんて; clause and quotation items accept なんて only. The neutral 'for example' use of なんか is explained in the article but not tested.

dispositions.levelEvidence: Bunpro N3; Sensei not verified (page blocked); SKM not checked
dispositions.note: Light entry (3 exercises): 一日おきに (every other day), a distance spacing, and 一行おきに. No item depends on the disputed reading of おきに with hours or with numbers above one day.

groups.reason: Selection between two particles; no form from another group must be produced.
Dictionary and ない forms are N5 knowledge; the base verb is supplied with its reading.
Selection between だけ and だけしか; restrict-restriction is recommended as review, not required.
Selection among three words; quantity-zutsu is recommended for depth, not required.

vocabulary.policy: Local displayed-form readings/glosses; no canonical word references; blank protected as grammar-target.

reviewLimits: No physical-device rendering check was performed.
Model-authored; independent model reviews recorded by the coordinator.

independentReview.method: Three blind single-facet reviews, each by a fresh agent with a different requested model family, given only the frozen render, raw set JSON, article and ledger: A linguistic correctness, B consistency and quiz safety, C learner comprehensibility. Findings were consolidated by the coordinator, applied by the author, and sent back to the original reviewers for a per-finding disposition.
independentReview.actualModelNote: The runtime does not expose the served model; the requested model is recorded.

reviews.finalVerdict: all findings resolved; no new findings

findings.claim: ずつ rationale said it needs a number with a counter; 少しずつ is also standard.
findings.change: Rationale now says ずつ follows a quantity and 人 alone is not one.

findings.claim: こそ rationale listed only nouns and reason phrases as hosts.
findings.change: List dropped; rationale says こそ cannot attach directly to a plain-form verb.

findings.claim: こそ rationale over-absolute about quotations (literary 〜とこそ exists).
findings.change: Rationale says こそ cannot replace the quotation particle と.

findings.claim: こそ described as following only nouns.
findings.change: Now 'usually follows a noun (sometimes a particle phrase such as 君にこそ)'.

reviews.finalVerdict: B-01, B-02 and B-03 resolved; B-04 raised in round 3 and fixed

findings.claim: Semantic だけ/だけしか contrasts were labelled N5 although the visible contrast is N3.
findings.change: Both relabelled N3; one-objection keeps N5 because its だけしか distractor is malformed with an affirmative predicate; counts updated.

findings.claim: ずつ was said to mean 'without skipping'; 一行ずつ is compatible with skipping lines.
findings.change: Claim removed from rationales and article; notebook items share an instruction asking for the word that makes the completed sentence describe the written/empty-line pattern.

findings.claim: Round-2 instruction 'だけしか needs a negative verb' revealed the answer of one-objection.
findings.change: Removed from all six pre-answer instructions; the rule appears only in post-answer feedback.

findings.claim: Round-3 'by itself' instruction conflicted with the item's explanation.
findings.change: Shared instruction now asks about the completed sentence; line-by-line's sentence carries どの行も空けないで.

reviews.finalVerdict: all findings resolved; no new findings

findings.claim: 'the sentence holds' wording opaque on a phone.
findings.change: Plainer 'the only one that is so, or the only one that is not'.

findings.claim: Model sentences lacked translations and readings.
findings.change: Meaning column with English; readings なべ and わりびき added.
